topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Of course, they want a piece of my yard now. Because why wouldn't they? I'm sure they've glanced over, noticed the neatly trimmed grass, the well-kept borders, and thought, "Why not just take a bit of that for myself?" I suppose I should feel flattered—my yard is a testament to my diligence, after all. Yet, there's a certain irony in their request. It's almost as if they're asking for permission to share in my hard work, my time, my space. As if the boundary between our properties isn’t clear enough. I suppose I can't deny them; it’s a small request in the grand scheme. But the principle of it all... It’s a little much to ask, don’t you think?
